{{Quote|Welcome! Welcome to The Galactic Archives, your one-stop source for everything that's worth knowing. Whatever you want, we have&mdash;or we'll get it for you, free...|Promotional slogan|<ref name="Shield of Lies">''[[Shield of Lies]]''</ref>}}
The '''Galactic Archives''' was an institution on the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] world of [[Atzerri/Legends|Atzerri]] which stored and collected information for research during the [[New Republic era]]. During his visit to [[Talos (spaceport)|Talos]] in [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]] in the midst of the [[Black Fleet Crisis]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] came across a satellite shop run by the Archives in the bustling [[Trader's Plaza]].

Using the pseudonym "Li Stonn", he inquired about information on a publication called ''[[The Lost Secrets of the Jedi]]'' in an attempt to discover the whereabouts of [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|his mother]]. The representative claimed he had such a book in stock but referred Stonn to the central archives location by a cab. Skywalker left the shop with several advertisements but was disappointed to find out that most of them were frauds.

It claimed to stock several books including the best-selling ''[[The Lost Secrets of the Jedi]]'', [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] ''[[Principles of Power]]'', the ''[[H'kig book of laws]]'' and a [[The secrets of forming Bilar-type claqa group-minds|book]] that claimed to hold the "secrets of forming [[Bilar]]-type ''[[claqa]]'' group minds."
